newsitem.title: PANAMA: Panama stock exchange volume up 160 pct in Q1.
newsitem.headline: Panama stock exchange volume up 160 pct in Q1.

text.p: Trading volume on Panama's budding stock market soared nearly 160 percent in the first quarter compared with the same period in 1996, an exchange spokeswoman said Wednesday.
The 11-share stock exchange traded $135.6 million from January to March, up from $52.2 million during the same period last year.
The spokeswoman attributed the increase to more local companies making bond issues.
"There is more confidence in the local economy and companies are looking for more financing to expand their projects," she said.
